content: Unknown unit g/m³, negative value -35, or hourly instead of annual mean survives partial token/unit checks as complete.
The prose branch validates only numeric tokens; a fabricated parking-lot permission claim attached to a real medical-wastewater quote is verified complete.
Coverage only requires edition labels: two correct PM10 rows produce complete for a PM2.5 comparison question.
Any dimensionless mention across caption/footnotes overrides the specific row unit; unrelated pH note converts total mercury mg/L into dimensionless complete.
